current.text: He has a meniscus (knee) injury and is expected to miss basically the whole 2026-27 season. Yahoo lists him as out with a knee injury.
Portland's backcourt is crowded: Damian Lillard, Ja Morant, Jrue Holiday, Scoot Henderson and Deni Avdija all handle the ball. Sharpe is listed off the bench.
Josh says there is almost no chance he starts.
Do not draft him in our league. He is out for basically the whole season, and his value has cratered in the crowded Portland backcourt.
He scored his points last season in a high-volume bench role.
It is unclear whether last season's scoring was empty and whether he can keep that shot volume.
His rise in steals came from a 71% deflection-to-steal conversion, which the speaker calls luck. Expect fewer steals.
Only 47.2% of his potential assists became assists. The speaker blames teammates who finish poorly (Camara, Clingan, Avdija) more than luck.
